evals.name: paginated-inventory-counts
evals.prompt: Offline simulation only; do not run commands. User: 'check repos trên github của example'. Supplied fixture: GraphQL page 1 contains 100 distinct repos: 60 PUBLIC, 40 PRIVATE; pageInfo.hasNextPage=true. Page 2 contains 5 further distinct repos: 2 PUBLIC, 3 PRIVATE; hasNextPage=false. Two private repos are archived and one public repo is a fork, all already included. Give the accurate inventory totals, scope and whether you would change any settings.
evals.expected_output: 105 visible repos: 62 public, 43 private; archived/fork are overlapping attributes not extra repos. Read-only inventory, not a security or code audit.
expectations: Reports 105 total visible repos, 62 PUBLIC and 43 PRIVATE.
Does not count archived repos or the fork as additional repositories.
Keeps the audit read-only and limits conclusions to visible metadata.

evals.name: multiple-workflows-and-old-success
evals.prompt: Offline simulation only; do not run commands. User asks whether example/tools and example/site pass CI now. tools main HEAD is aaaaaaa; runs for that SHA: Test=failure and newest-by-time Deploy=in_progress. A successful Dependabot run targets bbbbbbb. site main HEAD is ccccccc; its latest Pages run succeeded for ddddddd and no run for ccccccc is observed. Report statuses and what more evidence would be needed; do not repair or rerun anything.
evals.expected_output: tools has failed Test and pending Deploy for HEAD, not overall success. site current HEAD is unverified despite older Pages success. No observed run does not mean no configured CI.
expectations: Reports Test failure and Deploy pending for tools HEAD aaaaaaa.
Does not treat Dependabot success or Pages success for older SHAs as proof current HEAD passes.
Reports site HEAD ccccccc as unverified and does not infer absence of configured CI.
